en: "Captain! Enemy sighted!"
"Oho?"
"I took them for our old foe, the{n} Rheinmetall army, but is that not{n} just a shabby gang of rabble?"
"Most likely a band of drifters blinded{n} by the Almighty Treasure. No matter.{n} Wipe them out without a trace."
"Heh, listen to 'em run their mouths!"
"Would that be the Assyrian army?"
"Yeah. The Holy Nation of Assyria,{n} the military state of the south{n} that rivals Rheinmetall."
"Rheinmetall pushes with sheer numbers,{n} but Assyria's troops are top quality.{n} Get careless and you'll get hurt..."
"You are one step too late, you rabble."
"We have confirmed that a ring of the{n} Twelve Gods is here. A little sooner{n} and you might have beaten us to it!"
"A ring of the Zodiac Twelve Gods...{n} you say?"
"A ring of the Zodiac Twelve Gods...{n} you saaay?"
"Hmph, playing dumb, are you?"
"No matter. Suspend the search!"
"Sir!"
"Ever since we landed on this island{n} of steel, the enemy soldiers in our{n} way have been far too weak..."
"I was getting thoroughly bored."
"Listen, all of you!{n} Think of this as part of your{n} training! Finish it within 3:00!"
"Yes, sir!"
"You heard hiiim, Mr. {hero:6}?"
"Good grief, within 3:00?{n} That's a bit tight, but, well,{n} I guess I'll give it a shot!"
"Give it a shot... you say?"
"Yeah, it's training for us too.{n} We'll take you down within 3:00!"
"You heard that, {name:6}?"
"Wipe them out within 3:00?{n} That's quite a tall order,{n} isn't iiit?"
"A tall order... you say?"
"Yes, that's riiight. Beating all{n} of you within 3:00 does look{n} a little difficult, you seee."
"Ha... HAAH HA HA HA!"
"I'm amazed! This lot gets a joke far{n} better than Rheinmetall's soldiers!{n} A shame to just kill you!"
"No matter!"
"Within 3:00!"
"Before that time is up, I will{n} erase you from this world!"
"Move out! Battle formation! Teach{n} this rabble the might of Assyria's{n} soldiers, warriors of the desert!"
"Sir!"
"I shall sit back and watch from{n} above! They may be rabble, but{n} don't you dare let your guard down!"
"Let's go! Within 3:00!{n} Show them just how strong{n} this 'rabble' of theirs is!"
"Our target is within 3:00!{n} Let's show those people just how{n} strong their 'rabble' really iiis!"
"Within 3:00 is harsh, sir, but if{n} anyone can clear it, I'm sure{n} Lt. {hero:6} can!"
"The soldiers of the Holy Nation of{n} Assyria are known for their speed.{n} Please be very careful, sir!"
"Within 3:00? Easy-peasy! With my{n} Esper powers, any enemy goes{n} flying in one big ka-pooow!"
"{name:6}, do not mind the time{n} overmuch. Fight at thine own pace.{n} Haste will blunt thy true strength."
"C'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon!{n} Put me up front! One shot, one kill!{n} I'll settle this in no time flat!"
"It feels... like so long ago...{n} ...The Assyrian army... Once, I too...{n} served in the same army as those men..."
"But... that is... in the past."
"Now I belong... to no country...{n} ...to no army...{n} A killer... by the name of Jaguar..."
"If it is to be a short, decisive{n} battle within 3:00, my great magic{n} should prove useful."
"A short battle within 3:00, you say!?{n} I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Go a little easier on these old bones!"
"Enemy formation: truly perfect.{n} Unless this encirclement is broken,{n} victory within 3:00 is impossible."
"Even so, the way the Assyrian{n} soldiers move closely resembles{n} what my country calls ninja..."
"In truth, I would rather we talked{n} with each other and settled this{n} peacefully, but that cannot be."
"This will be a suuuper tough fight!{n} But Li'l Tethys will do her best{n} cheering you on from afar, yes indeed!"
"Eh? Cheering from afar won't do?"
"I see. Mere rabble, and yet you{n} bring down soldiers of our army?{n} You may amuse me a little after all."
"Very well!"
"Call in our special air unit!"
"With my unit's wings of hell, hurl{n} this rabble who know not their place{n} into the depths of terror!"
"Look at thaaat! The birdies!?"
"Yeah, a flock of griffons. There{n} aren't many left these days.{n} But that solves the mystery!"
"What mysteryyy?"
"Unlike Rheinmetall, the great power{n} of the north, Assyria in the south has{n} no landing ships or big air machines."
"So how did they get such a large{n} force this deep into the island{n} this quickly?"
"I see, it's the griffons, isn't iiit?"
"Yeah. They breed flocks of griffons,{n} control them somehow, and use them{n} in place of air machines."
"Damn you... my unit..."
"Why!? Why is my unit being{n} beaten by a pack of rabble{n} like this!?"
"And within a mere 3:00, no less!?"
"So what'll it be, Mr. Captain?"
"You are the only one left nooow.{n} Will you still go on fightiiing?"
"Graaaaaaagh!"
"Wiped out within 3:00... If I run{n} home like this, I'll be a{n} laughingstock until the day I die!"
"I-if it has come to this, then alone,{n} on the pride of the Assyrian army,{n} I'll slaughter every one of you rabble!"

"But they haven't wiped us out{n} either! Keep this momentum{n} and finish it in one push!"

"Still, these so-called Ancient Gods{n} sure made nothing but weird stuff."
"Seek out the statues...{n} In lands you have visited once...{n} and in lands you have yet to visit..."
"Find every statue of the Twelve Gods{n} and turn their power into rings."
